author: Creator Toolset
name: Writing basics
description: The team's default for the Content Workshop: write in the author's own words, concrete over general, and a review that reads like a stranger scrolling. Swap it for a community pack any time.

instructions.workshop.write: Write the way this author talks: reuse their phrases from their posts, notes and context before inventing new ones. Prefer the concrete case (who did what, the number, the moment) over a summary of it. Keep one idea per piece. Open with the most surprising true thing the piece has, not a warm-up. If a line can go without the piece losing anything, leave it out.
instructions.workshop.review: Read it as someone scrolling past who has never heard of the author. Point to the first line where they would stop reading and say why. Flag every claim a viewer could doubt that has no source in the piece or its notes.
